_comment: Copy this file to tenants.json and fill in your values. tenants.json is gitignored.

_authMethods.ClientSecret: Use a client secret stored in a file (recommended: restrict file permissions)
_authMethods.Certificate: Use a certificate for authentication (most secure, recommended for production)
_authMethods.Interactive: Browser-based interactive login (for ad-hoc use only, not suitable for automation)

_setupInstructions.multiTenantApp: Register ONE app in your service provider tenant, mark it as multi-tenant, grant admin consent in each customer tenant.
_setupInstructions.perTenantApp: Register a separate app in each customer tenant for full isolation.

defaultSettings._logAnalyticsNote: Configure logAnalytics per-tenant below. The app registration needs 'Log Analytics Reader' RBAC on each workspace.

tenants._note: Use certificateThumbprint for certs stored in the local certificate store
Use certificatePath for PFX file, certificatePasswordFile for the password file path

logAnalytics._note: Set enabled=true and fill in workspaceId to activate Log Analytics queries

tenants._note: Secret file must contain only the secret value (single line, no trailing newline)
Set enabled=false to skip this tenant without removing the config
